name: grok-build-harness
description: v0.1.1: Fresh-host bootstrap for the karlorz subagent harness — installs the custom grok-build-byok parent agent and scout subagent, agentrules.md routing rules, the subagent-contract AGENTS.md, and a sanitized BYOK config template, then adds the companion marketplaces and installs the plugin set with --trust. Idempotent, backup-first, GROK_HOME-aware for dry-run testing.
